channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Islanders Trade Maxim Tsyplakov To Devils For Ondrej Palat, Draft Picks
item.description: The New York Islanders acquired two-time Stanley Cup champion Ondrej Palat and two draft picks from the New Jersey Devils in exchange for Maxim Tsyplakov.

item.title: Sabres' Rasmus Dahlin Playing With Heavy Heart, Soft Hands And Light Feet
item.description: Buffalo Sabres captain Rasmus Dahlin has dealt with a lot off the ice this past year, which makes his success so far this season incredibly easy to cheer for.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: The Latest On Vincent Trocheck, Evander Kane And Shane Wright
item.description: The Minnesota Wild could be interested in New York Rangers center Vincent Trocheck, Evander Kane appears likely to be the next member of the Vancouver Canucks to be traded, and trade rumors are swirling around Seattle Kraken center Shane Wright.

item.title: Why It's More Likely The Maple Leafs Will Win The No. 1 Overall Pick Than Make The Playoffs
item.description: Following a disastrous 0-4-1 homestand that sunk Toronto to 11th place in the Eastern Conference standings, the Maple Leafs would have to go on a 17-11-1 just to get to 91 points, which was the cutoff for making the playoffs last season.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show: What's The Maple Leafs' Purpose For The Trade Deadline?
item.description: Drew Shore, Ryan Kennedy and Michael Traikos discuss the Islanders' trades, the Sabres' latest winning streak, the Leafs' trade deadline plans and much more.

item.title: NHL Power Rankings: Which Teams Will Be Trade Deadline Buyers Or Sellers?
item.description: The Montreal Canadiens and Vegas Golden Knights fell out of the top 10 of the NHL power rankings, but expect them to be buyers by the trade deadline.

item.title: Five NHL Play-By-Play Commentators Who Deserve The 2026 Foster Hewitt Memorial Award
item.description: Every year, the recipient of the Foster Hewitt Memorial Award gets recognized bythe Hockey Hall of Fame. There are many NHL play-by-play commentators deserving of the honor, but we look at five in particular.

item.title: The New York Islanders Aren't Taking A Hot Season For Granted With Latest Trades
item.description: New York Islanders GM Mathieu Darche made two notable trades this week, adding Carson Soucy and Ondrej Palat from rivals. As Darche rewards his team's strong start to the season, what else can we expect from the Isles?

item.title: 'The Room Has To Take Over': Flyers' Rick Tocchet Wants His Players To Hold Each Other Accountable
item.description: Flyers coach Rick Tocchet said the teams he's played on or coached have a history of players not being afraid to challenge each other in a good way. He wants his current squad to take that step.

item.title: Three Potential NHL Trade Fits For Canucks' Evander Kane
item.description: Vancouver Canucks veteran Evander Kane's grit and scoring touch could make him a valuable playoff rental, and he's in the trade rumor mill. Which NHL team is likely to be Kane's next destination?
